contexts.text: A sharp sickle () = the dispersion of evil and falsity. AE 272:10. ( = the Divine truth of the Word. Explained. AR 643. AR 645. AR 646. AR 647. AR 649.) ( = the Divine truth exquisitely exploring and separating. AE 908. AE 914.)
The Angel put his sickle into the earth, and vintaged the vine of the earth () = the end of the present Christian Church.
To put in the sickle = to collect the good, and separate them from the evil.
